entries.title: Job 14:1
segments: ¶"Man [who is] born of woman Is of few days and full of trouble.

entries.title: Job 14:2
segments: He comes forth like a flower and fades away; He flees like a shadow and does not continue.

entries.title: Job 14:3
segments: And do You open Your eyes on such a one, And bring me to judgment with Yourself?

entries.title: Job 14:4
segments: Who can bring a clean [thing] out of an unclean? No one!

entries.title: Job 14:5
segments: Since his days [are] determined, The number of his months [is] with You; You have appointed his limits, so that he cannot pass.

entries.title: Job 14:6
segments: Look away from him that he may rest, Till like a hired man he finishes his day.

entries.title: Job 14:7
segments: ¶"For there is hope for a tree, If it is cut down, that it will sprout again, And that its tender shoots will not cease.

entries.title: Job 14:8
segments: Though its root may grow old in the earth, And its stump may die in the ground,

entries.title: Job 14:9
segments: [Yet] at the scent of water it will bud And bring forth branches like a plant.

entries.title: Job 14:10
segments: But man dies and is laid away; Indeed he breathes his last And where [is] he?

entries.title: Job 14:11
segments: [As] water disappears from the sea, And a river becomes parched and dries up,

entries.title: Job 14:12
segments: So man lies down and does not rise. Till the heavens [are] no more, They will not awake Nor be roused from their sleep.

entries.title: Job 14:13
segments: "Oh, that You would hide me in the grave, That You would conceal me until Your wrath is past, That You would appoint me a set time, and remember me!

entries.title: Job 14:14
segments: If a man dies, shall he live [again]? All the days of my hard service I will wait, Till my change comes.

entries.title: Job 14:15
segments: You shall call, and I will answer You; You shall desire the work of Your hands.

entries.title: Job 14:16
segments: ¶For now You number my steps, But do not watch over my sin.

entries.title: Job 14:17
segments: My transgression [is] sealed up in a bag, And You cover my iniquity.

entries.title: Job 14:18
segments: "But [as] a mountain falls [and] crumbles away, And [as] a rock is moved from its place;

entries.title: Job 14:19
segments: [As] water wears away stones, [And as] torrents wash away the soil of the earth; So You destroy the hope of man.

entries.title: Job 14:20
segments: You prevail forever against him, and he passes on; You change his countenance and send him away.

entries.title: Job 14:21
segments: His sons come to honor, and he does not know [it]; They are brought low, and he does not perceive [it].

entries.title: Job 14:22
segments: But his flesh will be in pain over it, And his soul will mourn over it."
